name: skyshift
description: SkyShift local development runner (backend: FastAPI in backend/, frontend: Vite in frontend/)

scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn skyshift.api.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.test: npm run test:py && npm run test:web
scripts.validate: cd backend && uv run python scripts/validate.py
